text: Implemented a deterministic costed WL execution planner driven by sample count, feature cardinality, density, nonzeros, posting work, memory budget, requested output, Gram execution policy, and anticipated query novelty. It selects exact dense-scratch, feature-posting, or dense-row Gram paths and posting, sparse-merge, or dense query paths; OA retains the exact threshold-feature realization and explicitly reports why hierarchy intersection is not selected under the compiled query contract. Tiny-budget and parallel fallbacks are deterministic and every strategy is bit-identical in WLExecutionPlannerSuite.
